purpose: Prospective isolated-software feasibility measurement of repeated non-overlapping packet-arrival dispersion blocks. It is not an attack, health, receiver-outage, or recovery detector.
semantics: A Sync/Follow_Up gap enters one block only. On the eighth matched gap in a context, the block standard deviation is calculated and the block is cleared. A persistence observation requires two high-dispersion disjoint blocks whose final packets arrive within three seconds. Invalid, unmatched, reused-sequence, unsupported, and timestamp-regression results do not create a gap or default to healthy.
overlap_limit: V2's rolling eight-pair windows overlap. One gap can therefore generate several V2 candidates. V3's two blocks are disjoint observations, but are still software packet-arrival measurements and are not independent disturbances or physical-clock measurements.
parameter_status: All numeric values are provisional engineering parameters for this single prospective pilot. They are not calibrated deployment requirements, and V2/older data are development-only and excluded from V3 performance estimation.

required: Every capture passes structural validation and frozen inputs match before replay.
The non-overlapping persistence observation occurs in at least 4 of 5 netem runs.
It occurs in none of the 10 baseline and authorised-source-change no-action controls.
Report every run, first observation time, and all unknown/invalid states.
run_level_feasibility_gates.interpretation: These are prospective feasibility decision gates only. Passing would not establish detector performance, deployment suitability, or recovery efficacy; failing will be reported without tuning against these trials.

prohibitions: No future/EOF packet, filename, scenario label, or supplied outcome label is a feature.
No recovery action, physical timing, GNSS, SyncE, oscillator, attack, or receiver-outage claim follows from this observation.
